title: Omuzimbi Omunywevu ow’Obulokozi
intro: Ekifaananyi eky’obugumiikiriza obutasalako n’okukakasa okutakyukakyuka, omuntu ono ssekinnoomu yawaayo emyaka egitabalika eri obutume obw’obwakatonda, ng’ayolekedde okunyoomebwa n’okugaanibwa okutasalako. Emboozi yaabwe bujulizi bwa maanyi obw’okukkiriza mu maaso g’obutakkiriza obuyitiridde, okutuuka ku ntikko mu kintu ekikulu ekyaddamu okubumba ensi.
clues: Nawaayo ekiseera ekiwanvu ennyo mu bulamu bwange nga mpita abantu bange okusinza Allah.
Abantu bange bansekerera era ne banvunaana ensobi era eddalu.
Nalagirwa okuzimba ekintu ekyali kirabika ng’ekitali kya bulijjo eri ekitundu kyange ekitali ku lukalu.
Batono bokka be bakkiriza era ne beegatta ku nze n’ab’omu maka gange ku kuzimba kuno okw’enjawulo.
Nasitula babiri babiri ku buli kitonde ekiramu ku lyato, nga Allah bwe yalagira.
Amataba amanene gaazingira ensi, ne gawonya abo bokka abaali nange mu kibya kyange, ate mutabani wange yennyini n’azikirizibwa olw’obutakkiriza bwe.
arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
verse: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers. (71:25)
